pages.text: Used for everyday paving: frame an area of ground and replace the surface grass, dirt, sand, and stone directly with the chosen road material.

$(li)Enter the mode: press $(bold)V$() → the $(bold)Roads$() icon → select $(bold)Replace (REPLACE)$() in the mode bar → double-click a card in the bottom bar to pick a material.$(li)Frame the area: aim at the ground and $(bold)hold left-click and drag a box$() over the area to pave (the start lights up red, dragging pulls out a green selection), release to finish.$(li)Submit: check the selection and press $(bold)Enter$(). Wizard NPCs will execute the paving; once done it becomes a walkable road.$(br2)Picked the wrong spot? $(bold)Backspace$() to undo, or just drag a new box to overwrite. The paving reach is about $(bold)64 blocks$() — fly closer before selecting if the target is out of range.
